tooltip.text: The base class for all objects in the game.
A resource representing geometric data that can be rendered when attached to a Mesh object.
A resource representing procedurally generated geometric data that can be rendered when attached to a Mesh object.
An object composed of geometry and material that can be rendered in the scene.
A resource defining the appearance of an object, including its color, texture, and shading properties.
A resource defining the behavior of the GPU when rendering an object, including how it processes vertices, fragments, and other graphical data.
A resource defining a set of instructions that can be executed to control the behavior of objects in the game.
An abstract base class for value types in the game engine.
A resource representing an image that can be used as a texture or for other purposes in the game engine.
The position of an object in the game world.
The scale of an object in the game world.
The rotation of an object in the game world.
The name of an object in the game world.
The unique ID of an object in the game world.
The class name of an object in the game world.
The geometry that a Mesh object uses for rendering.
The material that a Mesh object uses for rendering.
The file path of a resource in the game world.
